items.html: And the son is found to have two matters: whether the illumination of his six extremities, through the springs and streams that go out from the river — and they are the six extremities of Bina that shine in his six extremities — this is called blessing, for the abundance of the pools of water drawn from the river, and it is also called the delicacy and the dainties of kings, which are the six extremities. And whether the inheritance of his father and his mother, to inherit the place of Hesed and Gevura, in his taking their root hidden above — this is called freedom, a free man, and it is called delight, as it is said: 'then you shall delight in the Lord.' And that is what is said there, in the portion Vayechi: 'all blessing and all freedom.'
